about: One-time, by-hand mood labels written by Claude for the 60 songs the user had hand-labelled. Not produced by any script and not reproducible: it is a snapshot for a theoretical test.
information_used: Exactly what the Gemini 'hybrid' prompt gets: title, artists, album, Last.fm tags and the ReccoBeats numbers when the song has them, plus the Mood Lab labelling rule, plus Claude's own knowledge of some songs. The user's labels and descriptions were NOT queried before these were written.
known_contamination: Earlier in the session Claude had seen the user's first 18 labels (a backup file) and the aggregate results of the Gemini run (label mix and confusion tables). The loader flags the songs whose earlier label was seen; score them separately.
